title: DevLog: Scripted Operations
description:
[Read on itch.io](https://ruinstars.itch.io/ruinstars/devlog/1032284/telling-a-story-scripted-operations)

While our Primary and Secondary Missions can be combined to create a full 3-operation/9-mission campaign, they don’t really tell a story. With that in mind, we started writing and prototyping scripted operations, where each mission has an impact on the following one, with branching missions determined based on success or failure.

title: Printing and Sharing
description: You can now print your squad to get standard cards for each of your Units, and you can also now share your squad links as a native share (on mobile) or a QR code.

title: New Faction - The Grutak!
description: Added [Krumpfists](/squadTypes/KF)! The Grutak Krumpfists are a brutal and relentless force on the battlefield.

title: Custom Portraits!
description: Your squads and units can now have custom portraits/photos!

title: Balance Update
description: Balance update for Interdictors (-1 HIT) and Silent Choir (+1 MSK).

title: Tokens
description:
Added Print-At-Home Tokens for objectives, crates, barrels, and Bugs.

Go to [Tools > Resources](/tools) for the full list of print-at-home files.

title: New SquadTypes
description: Added [Crimson Shroud](/squadTypes/CRS), [Eidolon Revenants](/squadTypes/EIR), and [Outer Claim](/squadTypes/OCL) squadTypes.

title: Injuries and Spoils of War
description: Added icons next to Unit names if they have Spoils of War or Injuries. These icons serve as reminders during gameplay.

title: Battlefields - Print-At-Home
description:
Added three print-at-home battlefield PDFs: The Ruined City, The Facility, and No Man's Land.

Go to [Tools > Resources](/tools) for the full list of print-at-home files.

title: Rules Updates
description: Clarified rules for movement, combat, cover, line of sight, and other gameplay mechanics. Added a [Glossary](/rules/#glossary) to the Rules.

title: Campaign Mode
description: Added [Campaign Mode](/rules#campaigns) to Ruinstars! You can now play through a series of missions with your Squad, gaining medals and experience and unlocking new abilities as you progress.

title: Published!
description: Ruinstars is officially published! You can now find the game on [itch.io](https://ruinstars.itch.io/ruinstars).

title: Ankh Revenants Updates
description: After thorough playtesting of the [Ankh Revenants](/squadTypes/ANKH) squadType, updated them for better balance.

title: Secondary Missions
description: Added support for secondary secret missions. You can now add secondary missions to your main mission, and they will be displayed in the mission list.
